messages.author: 079e6ad1842bcf44
messages.subject: function pmmlCanExport missing
parts:
Using R 3.0.2 64 bit on Windows 8.  as described in the book, I launch rattle and click on execute, ask for the weather dataset to be loaded and get the following error message

Error in ifelse(pmmlCanExport(variables[i]), "", Rtxt(". No code export")) : 
  could not find function "pmmlCanExport"

search () shows following packages

[1] ".GlobalEnv"         "package:pmml"       "package:XML"        "package:colorspace" "package:RGtk2"      "package:rattle"     "package:stats"      "package:graphics"   "package:grDevices"  "package:utils"      "package:datasets"  
[12] "package:methods"    "Autoloads"          "package:base"  

when I check the functions in pmml, I get

pmml.ada          pmml.coxph        pmml.cv.glmnet    pmml.glm          pmml.hclust       pmml.itemsets     pmml.kmeans       pmml.ksvm         pmml.lm           pmml.multinom     pmml.naiveBayes   pmml.nnet         
pmml.randomForest pmml.rfsrc        pmml.rpart        pmml.rules        pmml.svm          pmml::

and when I enter
 pmmlCanExport(y)  I get

Error: could not find function "pmmlCanExport".

I have no idea what to do next.  Any one help?

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: function pmmlCanExport missing
parts:
The pmmlCanExport is an issue with the new release of the pmml package - it is being addressed at present - a quick fix:

> pmmlCanExport <- function(...) TRUE
> rattle()

Regards,

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
